description: Create a short, consent-based intimacy challenge for a couple. Use for questions like "how do we reconnect", "how can we bring back some spark", or "we have drifted apart". Returns a day-by-day plan of non-explicit activities. 18+ only.

boundaries.description: Any boundaries or limits the user mentions, so the plan can explicitly respect them.

comfort.description: How much directness and playfulness the user wants. Bold still means non-explicit.

focus.description: The main goal. connection is a 7-day reconnection plan, reconnection is a 14-day plan for a longer dry spell, confidence is a 7-day confidence plan, play is a 7-day playful plan.

name: coral_create_intimacy_challenge
title: Coral intimacy challenge
